questions.question: What does the expression 'stop me if this rings true' mean in this context?
options: A) Make a phone call to stop someone
B) Interrupts me if what I'm saying sounds familiar/relatable to you
C) Stop me from ringing a bell
D) Ask me to stop talking about music
questions.explanation: 'Rings true' 是一个英语习语，意思是'听起来熟悉/有共鸣/让人觉得说到心里去了'。说话者用这个表达是希望对方如果也有同感就打断他，表示接下来的内容可能也是对方的经历。

questions.question: According to the speaker, what happened in February 2020?
options: A) She started a new job
B) She traveled around the world
C) Everything was great just before lockdown
questions.explanation: 字幕明确提到 'about february 2020 just before lockdown everything was great'，指的是2020年2月新冠疫情封锁之前一切都很好。

questions.question: The speaker says she 'did a pub quiz the other day' because she knows the other person loves what?
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'i did a pub quiz the other day because i know you...love pub quizzes big time harry potter'，她做这个酒吧知识竞赛是因为知道对方热爱哈利波特。

questions.question: How does the speaker describe the pub quiz she attended?
options: A) The most boring quiz ever
B) The most ridiculous quiz she has ever done
D) The easiest quiz in the world
questions.explanation: 字幕中她明确说 'it was the most ridiculous quiz I have ever done'（这是我参加过的最荒谬的知识竞赛）。

questions.question: One of the quiz questions mentioned in the video is about the referee for what event?
questions.explanation: 字幕提到 'who was the referee for like the 1964 Quidditch World Cup'，1964年魁地奇世界杯的裁判是谁。

questions.question: What is the name of Ron's rat in Harry Potter?
questions.explanation: 字幕中明确回答了 Ron's rat 的名字是 'Scabbers'。Scabbers 实际上是 Peter Pettigrew（小矮星彼得）的化名。

questions.question: What is revealed about Scabbers later in the story?
options: A) He is actually a cat
B) He turns into the bad guy / is Peter Pettigrew
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'turns into the bad guy or like i will accept peter pettigrew'，指的是 Scabbers 后来变成坏人（小矮星彼得）。

questions.question: What is the name of Hermione's cat?
questions.explanation: 字幕中明确回答了 Hermione's cat 的名字是 'Crookshanks'（克鲁克山）。

questions.question: According to the speaker, Crookshanks is technically what?
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'it's technically not a cat, it's half cat'，从严格意义上说它不是猫，它是半猫（实际上是半猫半克尼尔猫/Kneazle）。

questions.question: What is the name of Hagrid's dog?
questions.explanation: 字幕中回答 Hagrid's pet 的名字是 'Fang'（牙牙），是海格养的大猎犬。

questions.question: What is the name of Neville Longbottom's pet toad?
questions.explanation: 字幕中回答 Neville Longbottom's pet toad 的名字是 'Trevor'。

questions.question: The speaker says she can remember all the Harry Potter stuff, but in school she couldn't do what?
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'do a simultaneous equation, my brain was like, no'，她说自己上学时如果被要求做一道联立方程，大脑的反应就是'不行'。这是一个幽默的自嘲。

questions.question: When the speaker says 'I put it on my tree', what is she most likely referring to?
options: D) A tree in the garden
questions.explanation: 在哈利波特的背景下，'put it on my tree' 很可能指的是把信息放在家族树上（family tree），这是巫师们用来追踪血统和家族关系的图表。

questions.question: The speaker mentions 'it's not Gryffindor'. Which Harry Potter house is she ruling out?
questions.explanation: 字幕中明确说 'Now I know it's not Gryffindor'，格兰芬多（Gryffindor）是霍格沃茨的四大学院之一。

questions.question: What does the speaker ask viewers to do at the end of the video?
options: B) Subscribe and click the bell icon
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'don't forget to subscribe and click the bell icon'，这是YouTube视频结尾常见的呼吁订阅和开启通知的用语。

questions.question: Where can viewers find these interviews in full?
questions.explanation: 字幕中提到 'you can find these interviews in full on BBC iPlayer by searching Movies with...'，BBC iPlayer 是英国广播公司的流媒体平台。

questions.question: What phrase does the speaker use to mean 'I was very worried or scared for a moment'?
options: A) 'You were scared for a second there, weren't you?'
C) 'Going to run out of time'
questions.explanation: 字幕中 'God, you were scared for a second there, weren't you?' 是对方在确认回答者刚才是否因为不确定答案而感到紧张/害怕。

questions.question: What does 'I said whiskers' imply about the speaker's answer to Ron's rat question?
options: A) She gave the correct answer
B) She gave a wrong/uncertain answer (whiskers isn't the real name)
questions.explanation: 字幕中她先说 'I said whiskers' 然后对方纠正 'Scabbers'，说明 whiskers 是她不确定时随口说的错误答案，而正确答案是 Scabbers。

questions.question: Have you ever done a pub quiz? If yes, describe the experience. If no, would you like to try one? Why or why not?
questions.explanation: 这道口语题参考视频中提到的 pub quiz 经历，鼓励学生用英语分享自己参加酒吧知识竞赛或类似活动的经验。
questions.referenceAnswer: 可以分享参加 pub quiz 的经历，描述问题类型（如音乐、电影、历史、科学等），团队合作的过程，获胜或失败的感觉。如果没参加过，可以表达是否愿意尝试并说明原因。
questions.hint: Think about: what kind of questions were asked, did you win, who was on your team, how did you feel?

questions.question: Who is your favorite character in Harry Potter and why? Describe them in detail.
questions.explanation: 这道题参考视频关于哈利波特人物和宠物的讨论，鼓励学生用英语描述自己喜欢的角色及其原因。
questions.referenceAnswer: 可以谈论 Harry, Hermione, Ron, Dumbledore, Snape 等角色。描述其外貌特征、性格特点、重要的故事情节以及为什么喜欢这个角色。例如 Hermione 的聪明勇敢、Snape 的复杂性格、Dumbledore 的智慧等。
questions.hint: Consider: their personality, important moments, what they teach you, why they inspire you.

questions.question: The speaker can remember all Harry Potter details but struggled with math at school. Do you have a similar experience where you can remember trivia better than 'important' school subjects? Tell us about it.
questions.explanation: 这道口语题基于视频中 speaker 关于能记住哈利波特细节但不能做联立方程的自嘲，鼓励学生分享类似的经历。
questions.referenceAnswer: 可以分享自己在某些看似'无用'的领域（流行文化、电影细节、体育数据、游戏知识等）记忆力特别好，但在学校正式科目（数学、历史公式等）上却表现一般的经历。描述具体例子和感受。
questions.hint: Think about: pop culture facts, movie details, sports statistics, or other 'useless' knowledge you remember well.

questions.question: If you had a pet, what would it be and what would you name it? Why?
questions.explanation: 这道口语题参考视频中讨论的各种宠物（猫、狗、蟾蜍、老鼠等），鼓励学生用英语表达对宠物的喜好。
questions.referenceAnswer: 可以谈论想要养的宠物类型（猫、狗、鸟、鱼、爬行动物等），为它取的名字以及为什么取这个名字。可以结合宠物的性格、外貌特征或者参考自己喜欢的电影/书中的角色来取名。
questions.hint: Think about: the type of pet, the perfect name and its meaning, why you chose this name.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'going to run out of time' mean in this context?
options: A) There will be no more time available to complete something
B) The clock will stop working
questions.explanation: 'Run out of time' 是一个常用短语，意思是'时间用完了/来不及了'。在视频中，说话者用 'we're not going to run out of time' 来安慰对方不用担心时间不够。
